source_name: Asseco Central Europe — Referencie / solutions pages (SK banking)
why_relevant: Asseco CE is described as the largest IT provider to the Slovak private financial sector; its solution and reference pages (e.g. Core Banking System / Bankovy informacny system) reveal which bank programmes it runs, implying which delivery and bank-side teams are being staffed.

source_name: Asseco Case Study Book — Banking chapter
why_relevant: Group-level case-study repository; individual studies name the client bank, country, project scope and timeline (e.g. a 9-month Advisory Banking Platform delivery with SK/CZ/VN teams), exposing programme staffing and delivery-centre sourcing.

source_name: Asseco CE 'Napisali o nas' press clipping page
source_subtype: press clipping archive (pointer to SK trade media)
why_relevant: Vendor-curated clipping archive of Slovak media coverage of bank IT supply; one clipping explicitly discusses that Slovak banks do not name their IT suppliers, making this clipping trail the practical route into SK IT-trade press articles on bank programmes.

source_name: SOFTEC — Projekty / Banking segment
why_relevant: Softec publishes named Slovak bank projects (modern branch system, digital onboarding/remote identity verification) with client scale details (branch counts, user counts), which map directly onto bank operating-model and staffing change.

source_name: DATALAN — Referencie (finance sector)
why_relevant: Reference library segmented by sector including finance; individual references (e.g. software update in a financial institution) indicate ongoing supplier relationships with SK financial institutions even when the client is anonymised.

source_name: EEA s.r.o. — Referencie, banky a financny sektor
why_relevant: Slovak software house with an explicitly bank/finance-filtered reference list — a smaller-vendor view of which SK banks outsource development, and a snowball source for further bank names.

source_name: Principal engineering — projekty blog (bank IT body-shop deliveries)
why_relevant: IT contracting firm that publishes project posts such as supplying IT experts for a new internet banking platform — a direct signal of contractor headcount being placed into SK/CZ bank programmes.

source_name: KPMG Slovensko — Media / tlacove spravy (partner appointments)
why_relevant: KPMG SK publishes partner and associate-partner appointment releases naming financial-services specialisation (e.g. an FS audit lead becoming a CEE partner; five equity partners appointed effective 1 Oct 2024) — these are themselves A5 leadership-move events in the bank supplier ecosystem.

source_name: PwC Slovensko — Aktualne spravy (new partners / new directors)
why_relevant: PwC SK publishes named partner and director promotions with practice area and effective date (e.g. new directors effective 1 Sep 2026 across tax/legal, accounting advisory & capital markets, regional service centre) — direct A5 leadership and org-change events plus a signal on the SK service-centre buildout.

source_name: Deloitte Slovensko — Vedenie / leadership page
why_relevant: Canonical current-state roster of Deloitte's Slovak (CZ-SK cluster) leadership; diffing it over time detects FS-practice leadership changes even when no press release is issued.

source_name: EY Slovensko — sk_sk newsroom / careers
why_relevant: EY SK site carries strategy/transactions and FS practice contacts, sponsor relationships with SK banks (Slovenska sporitelna as exclusive partner of EY Entrepreneur of the Year), and career/hiring pages — a lead on FS practice staffing and senior-hire announcements.

source_name: Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia — corporate site (O nas / profil)
why_relevant: Kosice-based delivery centre, stated at >3,900 employees and among Slovakia's largest employers; its own headcount and org statements are a benchmark for the SK IT-services labour market that bank programmes compete in.

source_name: FinStat.sk — company financials & employee-band records for SK IT/consulting vendors
why_relevant: Aggregates SK register/financial-statement data including revenue and employee bands per legal entity (e.g. the DT Systems Solutions Slovakia and DT IT & Telecommunications Slovakia entities), letting supplier headcount be tracked quantitatively when companies do not publish it.

source_name: Profesia.sk — employer profile pages for bank IT suppliers
why_relevant: Dominant SK job board; per-employer pages for Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia, Erste Digital and other suppliers show live vacancy volume and role mix, the fastest-moving proxy for bank-project staffing ramps.

source_name: Erste Digital — corporate site (Bratislava/Kosice hubs)
why_relevant: Erste Group's captive IT arm with offices in Bratislava and Kosice and 2,000+ IT staff group-wide; it is the de-facto supplier to Slovenska sporitelna, so its SK site news and hub statements reveal bank programme staffing that SLSP itself does not disclose.

source_name: Temenos newsroom + partner announcements touching Slovakia
why_relevant: Core-banking vendor press releases occasionally name Slovak deployments or partners licensed to deliver Temenos Country Model Banks in Slovakia (e.g. an Orion Innovation agreement covering Ireland, Bulgaria, Hungary and Slovakia), pointing to which SI will be hiring for SK bank programmes.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld — Temenos T24 customer database
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator listing named institutions running a given core-banking product by country; a shortcut to hypotheses about which SK banks run which core, to be corroborated on vendor or bank sources.

source_name: GlobalLogic Slovakia — locations & corporate information
why_relevant: Large SK engineering employer (Kosice, Zilina, Banska Bystrica) that lists Finance among its industry verticals; site and careers pages track SK engineering headcount competing for the same bank-project talent pool.

source_name: SITA.sk — technology & business wire (SK)
why_relevant: Slovak news agency that carries verbatim corporate announcements, including Big-4 partner appointments naming financial-services roles; the most reliable SK-language wire for A5 leadership-move events in the supplier ecosystem.

source_name: FinReport.sk — Lidri section (SK finance leadership moves)
why_relevant: Slovak finance trade outlet with a dedicated leaders/appointments section covering banks and their advisers (e.g. KPMG SK equity-partner appointments); a purpose-built A5 leadership-move feed in local language.

source_name: Webmagazin/Teraz.sk business section (TASR-fed corporate appointments)
why_relevant: Republishes SK corporate appointment announcements (e.g. KPMG SK new partners), providing a redundant capture path when the primary newsroom page is restructured or removed.

source_name: ÚPSVaR – Hromadné prepúšťanie (employer duties + notification procedure)
why_relevant: Central Office of Labour, Social Affairs and Family is the statutory recipient of collective-redundancy notifications (§73 Zákonník práce). Defines what an employer legally must disclose, when, and to whom — the anchor for any SK bank/payment-firm headcount-cut signal.

source_name: ÚPSVaR – Otvorené údaje / mesačné štatistiky (open data)
why_relevant: Monthly open-data releases from the labour office information systems; the channel through which reported mass-redundancy volumes and unemployment inflows are published in machine-readable form. Best structured proxy for sector job destruction where employer names are withheld.

source_name: ÚPSVaR – Mediálne správy (press releases on mass redundancies)
why_relevant: The office periodically publishes aggregate counts of notified mass redundancies and threatened jobs — an authoritative, dated series that precedes media coverage and often contradicts employer framing.

source_name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin), Ministry of Justice SR
why_relevant: Statutory daily e-gazette carrying liquidation entries, liquidator notices, capital reductions, mergers, bankruptcy notices and ministry notices on representative higher-level collective agreements — covers exits and restructurings of banks, payment institutions and e-money firms before commercial-register updates.

source_name: Register úpadcov / new Register of pre-insolvency, liquidation and insolvency proceedings
why_relevant: Structured, searchable insolvency and liquidation proceedings register (superseding/absorbing Register úpadcov from the 2025 amendment to Act 7/2005). Data explicitly published in structured form permitting automated processing — the cleanest machine route to failure/wind-down of payment firms and fintechs.

source_name: Odborový zväz bánk a poisťovní (OZBP) – banking & insurance trade union
why_relevant: The active banking-sector union publishing its own account of sector bargaining: it filed a higher-level collective agreement proposal (May 2024), publicly accused the Slovak Banking Association of refusing sector bargaining, and asked MPSVR to appoint a mediator. Its demands explicitly cover AI impact on jobs and termination conditions — a direct, early read on bank workforce restructuring.

source_name: Odborový zväz pracovníkov peňažníctva a poisťovníctva (OZ PPaP)
why_relevant: Long-established finance-sector union federation with základné organizácie inside individual banks (e.g. Slovenská sporiteľňa). Publishes news, memoranda on employee rights and structure of its bodies — names the in-bank union counterparties that must be consulted before mass redundancy.
